image_description: A close-up view of a comic book cover featuring stylized, hand-drawn illustrations. The top section has a red background with bold, yellow and black title typography that appears distorted or non-standard. Below, two main characters are depicted: one on the left with dark hair wearing a pink outfit, holding a small object, and another on the right with dark hair in a black vest. The art style is reminiscent of underground comix or indie comics, with visible line work and flat coloring. There are additional smaller character sketches in the bottom left corner.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the title text. Use the Open Vocabulary Detector to see if the text matches any known comic styles or languages, distinguishing it from AI gibberish which OCR might just skip. For the spine, rely on the Geometric Depth Auditor to find the physical 'dents' of staples, as visual resolution is too low to see them directly. Scrutinize the interaction between the left character's hands and the object they are holding for any signs of melting or anatomical impossibility.
